name: sulfuric-acid-plant
description: Sulfuric acid: 1 chemical plant (1 s for 50 acid at speed 1). The plant could make 50 acid/s; its two fast inserters bring sulfur and iron fast enough for about 44 acid/s. Per acid it uses 0.1 sulfur, 0.02 iron plate and 2 water. One processing-unit-block uses 0.75 acid/s and one flying-robot-frame-block 3/s, so this feeds 58 processing-unit-blocks or 14 robot-frame blocks (if the sulfur keeps up: 0.075 sulfur/s per processing-unit-block). Power about 0.3 MW peak (210 kW + 2 fast inserters).

inputs.what: sulfur + iron plates on separate lanes (belt runs south)

power: connect any of its small poles to your grid
